treasure.name: golden treasure
treasure.description: A heavy golden idol. This is what you came for.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: An unlit torch, still usable as a light source.

statue.name: stone statue
statue.description: A weathered statue of a forgotten king. Too heavy to move.

silver_ring.name: silver ring
silver_ring.description: A tarnished silver ring, said to bring luck.

keeper.name: old keeper
keeper.dialogue: I've guarded this hall for years. Bring me the torch and I'll reward you.
keeper.traded_dialogue: Thank you for the torch. Take care of that ring.

hall.name: Grand Hall
hall.description: A dusty entrance hall. Cobwebs hang from a cracked ceiling.

library.name: Library
library.description: Rows of rotted bookshelves line the walls.

vault.name: Vault
vault.description: A small stone vault, heavy with the smell of old gold.

outside.name: Outside
outside.description: Sunlight. Fresh air. Freedom, if you're carrying what you came for.
